title: Restore existing AE crate rewards after the 9.24.15 upgrade
assumptions: Read-only spawn journal at 2026-10-04T15:09Z: five unprepared ARC_CURRENT AE receipts (dust 16 and 32, black scrolls 2 and 4, randomizers 8). Two older FROZEN_ITEMS and two prepared MAIL receipts are separate recovery cases.
The patch adds the verified AE 9.24.15 factory version alongside 9.24.13. Reward identities, weights, quantities, success percentages, free-key periods and paid-key prices are unchanged.

The observed five receipts can release at most 48 dust, 6 black scrolls and 8 randomizers in total, subject to successful claim and inventory capacity. This is one finite backlog, not recurring daily income.

Low/base/high assume 0/1/2 already-selected AE receipts claimed per affected player-day. Participants 1/2/5 and a five-receipt cap describe only the observed recovery week; they are sensitivity assumptions, not measured player activity.

Ordinary future AE rewards regain the same configured item progression as the previously compatible provider. No new roll, extra debit, reroll, boost, money redemption or automatic grant is introduced.

Native AE item progression is not converted to vault or tokens. SELL-to-contract plans and the current SELL state are unchanged. Repeat clicks reuse the existing opening and frozen preparation receipt.
Delivery requires spawn ARC activation and a player claim; survival restart is explicitly deferred. Live claim acceptance remains to be observed.

flows.basis: One already-selected reward per existing opening; never create a replacement opening or redraw the reward.
